a: Under a `ReadOnly` scope, Delete/Backspace on a stop handle and the Remove button still remove a stop
Held (disabled/read-only) GradientHandles overlay still reports `onInput(start)` and `onCancel` on an Escaped drag
Removing a stop moves the selection before the commit, so a caller that declines the removal is left on a different stop
b: A held (disabled/read-only) overlay still sends onInput and onCancel when a drag on it is canceled
An arrow key pressed during a pointer drag overwrites the drag's start, so canceling the drag afterwards doesn't restore the value
Removing a stop moves the selection before the commit, so a declined removal leaves the selection on a different stop
Removing the selected stop when it is first along the gradient at stored index 0 does not fire onSelectionChange
